title: flows step
description: A flows step: optional keys, then the Markdown every flow that names the step copies in byte for byte. compose.ts reads its keys, types and values from here.

in.description: Every converted conductor (a SKILL.md holding [step: phases]) must use this step.

uses.description: The skills, agents and tools the text runs.

requires.description: Steps that must also be in any flow using this one.

writes.description: flow.md sections the text writes, checked against the flow's templates.

needs.description: The text dispatches subagents, so it holds a line starting "Without subagents:".

repeat.description: The step may appear more than once in a file.

text.description: The step's Markdown, in a multi-line literal string whose opener stands alone on its line: text = '''
